Name: Memory Album - Photos and Milestone Memories
Author: YGSnaffy
Description:
[size=5][b]Memory Album[/b][/size]
[i]Take photos, ask your friends to pose, and look back on how your farm, family and friendships grew over the years.[/i]

Take out a camera, snap date-stamped photos, and keep them in an in-game album. Villagers will pose with you once you're friends, and the album photographs the big moments by itself: your wedding, your children, the Community Center ceremony, and more.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]A camera.[/b] Press [b]O[/b] to open the viewfinder. The HUD hides so you can frame the shot; click to take a photo. Photos never include the HUD or menus, so cutscenes and festivals make great pictures.[/*]
[*][b]Date stamps.[/b] Every photo gets the in-game date in the corner, like an old film camera.[/*]
[*][b]Pose with villagers.[/b] Stand next to someone and right-click to ask them to pose. Friends say yes, best friends get excited, your spouse always says yes, and people you barely know politely decline. Children and pets pose too.[/*]
[*][b]Milestones, captured for you.[/b] Your wedding (at the kiss), engagement, each new child, the Community Center ceremony, house upgrades, pets, new best friends, the greenhouse, each new year, perfection and your very first day.[/*]
[*][b]An in-game album.[/b] Press [b]L[/b] to flip through polaroids. Filter by milestones, favorites, posed photos, year, or who's in the picture.[/*]
[*][b]Captions and favorites.[/b] Write a caption for any photo, favorite it, or delete it.[/*]
[*][b]Share-ready polaroids.[/b] Export a framed image with your caption and date underneath. Perfect for Reddit, Discord and TikTok.[/*]
[*][b]"On this day."[/b] Some mornings you'll be reminded of a photo from the same day in an earlier year.[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves welcome.[/b] Milestones you reached before installing are skipped quietly.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]O[/b]: take out or put away the camera[/*]
[*][b]Left-click[/b] (controller [b]X[/b]): take a photo[/*]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] (controller [b]A[/b]) next to someone: ask them to pose[/*]
[*][b]L[/b]: open the album[/*]
[/list]Both keys can be changed (or given controller buttons) in the config.

[size=4][b]Where are my photos?[/b][/size]
In the game's screenshot folder, under [b]MemoryAlbum[/b]. On Windows: [b]%AppData%\StardewValley\Screenshots\MemoryAlbum\[/b]. The album has an [b]Open folder[/b] button. Each farm gets its own album, and nothing is stored in your save file except a few milestone flags.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] or use Generic Mod Config Menu.
[list]
[*][b]Camera key[/b] / [b]Album key[/b] (default O / L)[/*]
[*][b]Date stamp[/b] on photos (default on)[/*]
[*][b]Shutter sound and flash[/b] (default on)[/*]
[*][b]Hide HUD while framing[/b] (default on)[/*]
[*][b]Hearts needed to pose[/b] (default 2)[/*]
[*][b]Capture milestones[/b] automatically (default on)[/*]
[*][b]Milestone messages[/b] (default on)[/*]
[*][b]"On this day" reminders[/b] (default on)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+ on Windows, Mac and Linux.[/*]
[*]No Harmony patches and no changes to game data.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer and split-screen. Each player has their own album.[/*]
[*]Custom NPCs (like Stardew Valley Expanded's) can pose and are tagged in photos.[/*]
[*]Mods that draw their own HUD overlays may appear in photos.[/*]
[*]Safe to remove at any time.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
Open source (MIT): [url=https://github.com/La2o/StardewValley-MemoryAlbum]GitHub[/url]. Bug reports and translations are very welcome! All text lives in [b]i18n/default.json[/b].
